title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
summary: Return the value that occupies position k in descending order, with position one holding the largest value.

contractDetails.constraints: 1 ≤ k ≤ array length ≤ 100,000. Values are integers in [−10,000, 10,000].

statement: Return the value that occupies position k in descending order, with position one holding the largest value. Count duplicate entries separately. Solve without sorting the entire array.

examples.explanation: The two copies of 8 occupy the first two positions.
A singleton has only one rank.

constraints: 1 ≤ k ≤ array length ≤ 100,000. Values are integers in [−10,000, 10,000].
hints: Conceptual: Only the count of entries above a value determines how close it is to the requested position.
Directional: The bounded value range lets you count frequencies by value.
Implementation: Scan frequencies from the highest value downward, subtracting each count from k until the remaining rank falls within a bucket.
complexityAnalysis: O(n+U) time and O(U) auxiliary space with a counting array, where U is the value-range size.
